stem:
Sameer places a treasure on the number $48$ on a number strip. He may jump by a fixed whole-number size from $0$ and wants every landing to hit $48$ exactly.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The answer is $48$, because that is the treasure number itself.
Jump size $5$ works, because repeated jumps of $5$ stay on whole numbers.
Jump size $48$ is forced, because $48$ is the largest printed mark on the strip.

teacher.key_rationale: A jump size lands on 48 exactly when it divides 48. Those sizes are the factors listed in A. Naming the treasure number itself swaps the jump-size answer. Jump 5 omits the no-remainder condition. Picking 48 only because it is the largest mark is surface capture.
